bi.title: Profitability
bi.subtitle: Work orders, time, first-time fix and estimated/actual revenue by department, customer and technician.

errors.invalid: The filters are invalid. Check the period and try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to the profitability report.
errors.tooLarge: The data set is too large. Choose a shorter period or a narrower filter.

estimate.title: Revenue and profit are estimates
estimate.basis: Basis: {basis}. {coverage} of work orders have an hourly rate.
estimate.costMissing: Profit is not calculated because the internal cost rate is missing.
estimate.costConfigured: Profit is calculated with an internal cost rate of {rate} per hour.

actual.availableDescription: Actual revenue is the net invoiced amount excluding VAT for {invoices} invoices in the period. Draft invoices are excluded, credit notes are deducted, and payment status does not affect revenue recognition. The estimate from the contract hourly rate is shown alongside.
actual.unavailableDescription: Actual revenue is unavailable because the invoicing module is off, or because there are no non-draft invoices for the work orders in the period. The estimate is calculated from the contract hourly rate and work time.

basis.contract_price_list: hourly rate from the contract price list
basis.partial: hourly rate missing for some work orders

capacityBasis.mixed: a mix of capacity plans and working hours

kpis.title: Key figures
kpis.completionRateSub: Completed work orders of all in the period
kpis.revenueSub: from {orders} work orders with an hourly rate
kpis.profitSub: after an internal cost rate of {rate}/h

chart.title: Hours per technician
chart.description: Bars show total work and travel time. Availability is based on {basis}.
chart.note: Work {work} h and travel {travel} h are included in the total. A shared visit counts for each technician in the table, but only once in the total.

empty.title: No work orders in the period
empty.description: Adjust the period or choose another department, customer or technician.

tables.techniciansDescription: Work orders, hours, utilisation and estimated/actual revenue.
tables.customersDescription: Work orders, hours and estimated/actual revenue per customer.
tables.ordersDescription: {count} work orders in the period with time, first-time fix and estimated/actual revenue.
